Pass 2 (2026-09-23): Openverse queries 'Sparkman Wharf Tampa' (1 result: the same Commons grand-opening photo centered on Mayor Bob Buckhorn, still a people-rule reject), 'Sparkman Wharf' source=flickr (0) and 'Sparkman Wharf shipping container' (0) found nothing new of the food hall. A verified photo of the real Pirate Water Taxi was found and used for the Tampa Riverwalk guide's 'Sparkman Wharf and the water taxi' pick, whose own blurb names the water taxi; it was not reused here because this guide's 'Sparkman Wharf' pick and blurb describe only the food hall/lawn, not the taxi, so captioning the taxi photo here would not honestly match what this specific pick names.

Pass 2 (2026-09-23): Openverse query 'Adventure Island Tampa' with source=flickr (56 results) found real 2012 photos from Tampa's park (matching slides, pools and rockwork), but every candidate centers on identifiable people as the subject — including one literally titled 'Kim at Adventure Island, Tampa, Florida' — and several feature children as the clear focus, both excluded by the people rule.
